name: Mulciber
description: Category C, classical borrowing: Milton's name for the fallen Vulcan/Hephaestus, the Greek/Roman fire-and-forge god. Milton explicitly identifies him with the classical architect-god who 'fell from Heaven' -- echoing Hephaestus's mythic fall from Olympus -- and was later worshipped as Vulcan/Mulciber. Not biblical at all. See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §II.
narrative_function: Designs and builds Pandemonium from the gold Mammon's crews mine -- keep distinct from Mammon in prose; popular shorthand conflates the two roles.
